## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Reproduction or UI comparison

For UI changes, provide steps to exercise the changed interaction and sanitized before/after evidence when available. Include the reference app version or recording timestamp, client version, theme, window size, and zoom used for comparison.

For other changes, explain how a reviewer can verify the result. State any remaining limitations.

## Validation

Mark the checks you ran and add the result. Explain skipped checks; documentation-only changes usually need a link and formatting check.

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Relevant tests or `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual interaction check, when applicable

## Before submitting

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work and followed the public-source boundary in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/keriae/codex-app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Files, screenshots, and logs contain no credentials, private conversations, account data, personal paths, application bundles, extracted vendor source, or unlicensed vendor artwork.

New contributors are welcome. If you need help with a check or part of the implementation, describe it here so reviewers can help.
